aboutGame.title: What is NBA Heroes?
paragraphs: NBA Heroes is a fast-paced Roblox basketball game built around 3v3 matches and NBA-inspired heroes. Pick a player, master unique abilities, and outscore your opponents with teamwork and skill.

Whether you are learning the basics, climbing the competitive ladder, or hunting for the best hero builds, our wiki covers every system with detailed guides, data tables, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about NBA Heroes.

items.question: What is NBA Heroes?
items.answer: NBA Heroes is a free-to-play Roblox basketball game focused on fast-paced 3v3 matches. You pick NBA-inspired heroes, each with unique abilities, and compete to outscore the opposing team.

items.question: Which hero should beginners pick?
items.answer: Start with a balanced all-around hero that is easy to control, then experiment with specialist scorers and defenders once you learn the match flow.

items.question: Are there active NBA Heroes codes?
items.answer: There are currently no confirmed working codes. Check the Codes page regularly for new rewards and redeem instructions.

items.question: What game modes are available?
items.answer: The core mode is 3v3 basketball, with quick matches, progression rewards, and competitive play against other Roblox players.

items.question: How often is NBA Heroes updated?
items.answer: NBA Heroes receives updates on a weekly cadence, adding new heroes, abilities, balance changes, and limited-time rewards.
